system.description:
You quickly spin your weapon around you, using chakra to extend its range further. Your weapon gains +1 rank of Reach until the end of the current turn. All creatures within range must make a Dexterity Saving Throw. On failed save they take [Weapons damage] + 1d6 or half as much on a success.

Chain 1: Creatures who failed their saving throw gain a rank of Bleeding. At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
